skill.summary: Manage MoreLogin anti-detect browser profiles and cloud phones through the official Local API (http://127.0.0.1:40000), including browser profile lifecycle,...

latestVersion.changelog:
**Removed legacy CLI entry points and restricted direct command execution for improved security.**

- Removed CLI files: `bin/cloudphone.js`, `bin/start-profile.js`, `bin/test-api.js`.
- Disabled local ADB/SSH connection methods and direct `cloudphone exec` capability.
- Updated documentation to reflect removal of direct command execution endpoints.
- Focused all usage and automation guidance on supported Local API methods only.
